_what_this_is: The machine-readable register of every measured ArifiLabs win that an upstream bump or a
fork ingest must not silently overwrite. President mandate 2026-09-04, assignment 2.
Read by: arifi_sync.py `protected-win validate|check|discover`, and by `bump` at leg 1b,
which REFUSES when an incoming change collides with an entry and no measured comparison
AUTHORED, NOT GENERATED. protected_paths, anchors, quality_gate and workload are not
derivable from a commit trailer, and a fabricated value would make the guard lie. The
candidate set IS derivable and `protected-win discover` prints it, so a measured win
cannot quietly stay unregistered. An entry that cannot be completed honestly stays out
of this file and stays on that list.

_schema.evidence: a repo- or studio-relative path, or `commit:<sha>` when the measurement table lives in the commit message
_schema.anchors: distinctive symbols/env gates whose REMOVAL by an incoming diff is itself a collision, even when the file survives. Searched in SOURCE only: an anchor names a mechanism in LIVE CODE, so every home that merely RECORDS the name is excluded - `patches/series/` because this fork bakes every mechanism into a generated patch (R6 finding 2); `tools/arifi-sync/` because THIS FILE is tracked and lists every anchor literal by construction, which made the rule structurally unable to report any anchor absent (R6B, the blocking finding); and `*.md` plus root `docs/` because prose is not a mechanism (R6B note N2). Write an anchor that only prose says, and validation will correctly call it absent. Full contract: UPDATE-RUNBOOK 4.3 and the `_anchor_present` docstring
_schema.protected_paths: a file, or a DIRECTORY. A directory is matched on the `<dir>/` boundary against the incoming change, so a whole subtree is genuinely guarded (R6 finding 1). The price is real - ANY touch under a protected subtree refuses until a comparison is recorded - so a subtree is registered only where the tree is ours
_schema.supersession_law: A superseded win is NEVER deleted. It keeps its entry, its evidence and the valid_conditions it still wins under, per the mandate's condition of validity.

wins.mechanism: Tiled CONCAT dispatch for a transposed src1, taken on the delta-net conv state. A dedicated concat_transpose shader plus a selector branch ahead of the pre-existing cpy_transpose_02_32/02_16 tiled branch; the two predicates select disjoint pipelines.
wins.quality_gate: ON-vs-OFF generated text byte-identical at temp 0 / top_k 1 / presence_penalty 0 on the canonical binary (QUALITY-CANON.json, 3/3), F-141 0/8 on every slot (f141-canon/F141.json), test-backend-ops -o CONCAT 195/195 0 FAIL both arms.
wins.workload: Huihui-Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated-UD Q4_K_XL on the seat serve line (-dev Vulkan0 -ngl 999 -fa on -c 8192 -b 1024 -ub 512 -t 16 -tb 32 -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 --jinja); op-level receipt via llama-bench -p 2048 -n 0 -ub 512 -ngl 999 -fa 1 -t 16 -r 1 with GGML_VK_PERF_LOGGER=1, Balanced power plan.
wins.measured_effect: CONCAT dispatch -12.79% (-15.66 ms per ub512 prefill graph) on the LANE binary; end-to-end ceiling +0.18%, serve-level TIED on all three shapes across two counterbalanced takes. A canonical-binary re-measurement is banked separately in rank3-r10/71-PERF-CANON.json.
wins.valid_conditions: Fires only where src1 is transposed with nb[0] > nb[1] and src0 ne[2]==ne[3]==1 - the delta-net conv-state shape. test-backend-ops carries no case of that shape, so the suite proves non-regression, not coverage.
wins.notes: The win is op-level and statistically zero at the seat. It is retained anyway: a win is a win even if it is small (mandate root cause 1).

wins.mechanism: Subgroup-cooperative TQ mat-vec. Register WHT via subgroupShuffleXor replaces the 32-thread shared-memory butterfly, removing hot-loop barriers and unpinning the workgroup. The legacy 32-thread shaders remain as the fallback for devices without 32-multiple subgroups.
wins.quality_gate: Build-time CPU/GLSL mirror-pair registration in ggml/src/ggml-vulkan/arifi_sync_check.py (49 -> 52 pairs); float rotated activation throughout, so the mmvq-tq fp16-store bias cannot recur; test-backend-ops TQ coverage green.
wins.workload: 780M, llama-bench/llama-server: 27B tq3_4s tg32, and 0.5b tq4_1s / tq3_1s tg64 (lane-163).
wins.valid_conditions: Devices whose subgroup size is a multiple of 32. Elsewhere the legacy shaders are the correct path and must survive with it.

wins.mechanism: Column-blocked escha_mm: one weight decode serves C columns, removing redundant decode work rather than load pressure. C=8 shipped, with a fall-back to the one-column pipeline below a full block, and every dispatch bounded to 32 columns (the F-124 host-freeze guard).
wins.quality_gate: tests/test-backend-ops.cpp ESCHA_MM cases at real 27B shapes (ncols=9), 10/10 GREEN; the f32->f16 convert must stay float16_t, not packed - a one-ulp truncation there corrupted 25.6% of codewords once already (974d46603).
wins.workload: test-backend-ops perf -b Vulkan0 -o ESCHA_MM, Balanced, one session: escha2 5120x12288 and escha3 17408x5120 at ncols 1 / 8 / 64.
wins.measured_effect: 3.51x on escha3 17408x5120 at ncols=64 (135386 -> 38587 us), 3.09x at ncols=8; decode held at baseline (2856 vs 2831 us at ncols=1) by the threshold.
wins.valid_conditions: Prefill shapes with ncols >= ESCHA_MM_COLS. Below the threshold the one-column pipeline is the winner - C=4 made decode 11-27% SLOWER - so the threshold is part of the win, not an optimisation of it. ESCHA_SG_HADAMARD stays OFF by default: the lever was refuted by measurement.
wins.notes: C=16 is the next untested step and is deliberately not assumed.

wins.mechanism: Full 64-bit pair sourcing plus the row-parity correction in the Escha weight decode. K=2 had windowed a bare u16 where the reference PTX builds a 64-bit pair and windows a 32-bit suffix, so 7 of every 8 weights decoded from truncated data; the tile scatter row term used (c & 1) where the PTX predicate inverts it, which nulled K=3.
wins.quality_gate: Whole-tensor correlation against a known-good GGUF of the same base checkpoint over 25 projections: worst 0.9358, median 0.987, with the positive control run FIRST. End-to-end Vulkan coherence PASSES. A test that compares our two implementations against each other does NOT satisfy this gate - that is precisely what missed both defects.
wins.workload: Escha-W2 native decode, Vulkan path, K=2 and K=3.
wins.measured_effect: Escha-W2 native decode goes from token salad to coherent; worst-projection weight correlation 0.000 -> 0.9358, K=2 and K=3 both correct.
wins.valid_conditions: Escha weight decode at K=2 and K=3. This is a CORRECTNESS win, so an incoming change that is faster but re-truncates the pair sourcing loses outright - speed cannot buy this one back.
wins.notes: Registered because the mandate's protection is of the winning FORMULA, and a decode that is fast and wrong is not a candidate at all.

wins.mechanism: Dual residency for the VNNI weight repack (GGML_ARIFI_VNNI_REPACK=2): keeps the decode win of mode 1 while leaving prefill on its original path, and fixes the hot-path cost that ate the first implementation.
wins.quality_gate: Bit-identical to mode 1 and placement-identical to mode 0 across the correctness sweep. That sweep alone is NOT sufficient - the first version passed it and was slower than doing nothing - so the timed A/B is part of the gate.
wins.workload: RIG-A, llama-server, two g64 models, -ngl 0 --no-host -c 2048 -t 8, 519-token prefill, n_predict 128, temp 0, three interleaved replicates x 5 rolls, roll 1 dropped, n=12 per cell, one binary with only the env flip.
wins.measured_effect: decode +22.0% (mixed) and +23.7% (all-Q2_0) against mode 0, ranges DISJOINT, with prefill held at baseline (958.96 vs 898.11 and 963.51 vs 905.25 prompt t/s, ranges overlapping so no prefill gain is claimed).
wins.valid_conditions: CPU tier, g64 ternary models, -ngl 0. Mode 1 remains the wrong trade on this workload: it pays -65% to -80% of prefill for the same decode.

wins.mechanism: Generic MoE streaming hook with a SiLU op-type and standalone expert prefetch - the warm-regime fix for disk-streamed sparse inference.
wins.quality_gate: Coherent output on the streamed path (the repack carve-out at 11c9a7702 exists because AARCH64 repack of streamed experts produced garbage), verified per lane-110C round.
wins.workload: llama-server, streamed-MoE expert bundle, lane-110C rounds on RIG-A.
wins.measured_effect: server decode climbs 5.99 / 9.79 / 10.48 / 12.31 t/s against the fork's best 9.00 (RESULTS lane-110C).
wins.valid_conditions: Disk-streamed sparse MoE with an expert bundle present. Inert without one.

wins.mechanism: Per-ubatch pipeline init with guarded reuse, so the streamed-MoE pipeline is rebuilt only when it must be.
wins.quality_gate: Output coherence re-checked on the reuse path (lane-110C round 2); the guard is what makes reuse safe, so a change that reuses unguarded fails this entry even if it is faster.
wins.workload: llama-server, streamed-MoE, lane-110C round 2 on RIG-A.
wins.measured_effect: 9 of 263 rebuilds; pipeline init 2472 us -> 0-2 us, about 2.5 ms per token, output coherent.
wins.valid_conditions: Streamed-MoE path with the per-ubatch pipeline in play.

wins._registered: 2026-09-05, lane-209 rank-3 R6. Was `REGISTRATION OWED` (bca0f5b9a), noted as real and measured; the entry below is that row written out.
wins.mechanism: GPU-safe staging edge for the streamed-MoE pipeline: ggml_moe_pipeline_build_tasks builds its output with ggml_dup, not ggml_view_tensor. A view keeps sharing the source buffer, so with -ngl the CPU-side pipeline op would dereference a device pointer; the dup gives the op its own tensor and lets the scheduler insert the device-to-host copy. Carries the CPU zero-copy path and the LANE110_PROF per-op timing gate alongside it.
wins.quality_gate: The GPU arm must RUN clean, not merely start - the failure this fixes is a segfault on a device pointer, so 'it launched' is not the gate. Coherent output with -ngl 99 -cmoe on the streamed path, lane-110B/C, with the CPU zero-copy arm still coherent in the same round.
wins.workload: RIG-A, llama-server, streamed-MoE expert bundle, -ngl 99 -cmoe; lane-110B/C rounds.
wins.measured_effect: GPU -ngl 99 -cmoe clean at 4.9 t/s with CPU zero-copy retained (RESULTS lane-110B/C).
wins.valid_conditions: Streamed-MoE with any GPU offload in play. With -ngl 0 the dup is redundant but harmless; it must survive anyway, because the defect only appears on the offloaded arm.

The anchors catch what actually threatens this win - a renumbering or removal of the type/ftype ids. That is a signal-to-noise choice and it is named here so it can be revisited, not discovered.

wins.mechanism: The measured DEFAULT decision on top of the VNNI repack slot: ggml_arifi_vnni_repack_enabled() returns true only for an exact "1", so unset takes the no-repack branch. This DIVERGES DELIBERATELY from PrismML's upstream default of ON. It is a different object from the kernel it gates - `cpu-vnni-repack-dual-residency` protects the kernel, and every anchor of that entry would still resolve after this default was flipped back.
anchors: DEFAULT OFF. Only an exact "1" enables the slot
wins.opt_out: GGML_ARIFI_VNNI_REPACK=1 restores the upstream default behaviour exactly
wins.quality_gate: ENGAGEMENT re-verified in BOTH arms on one binary with only the env flip: unset produces no `load_tensors: CPU_REPACK model buffer size` line at all, `=1` produces it (4.68 MiB on the g64 fixture), and both arms return coherent text with no NaN. A default that reads as OFF but still allocates the repack buffer has not passed this gate.
wins.workload: RIG-A, llama-server per F-085, `-ngl 0 --no-host -c 1024 -t 8 -v`, temp 0, top_k 1, seed 42, cache_prompt false, fresh server per arm, env flip only; the numbers below come from the earlier full protocol in docs/OPTIONS-REGISTRY.md (two g64 models, three interleaved replicates x 5 rolls, roll 1 dropped, n=9 per arm).
wins.measured_effect: The DECISION is what is measured, and it is a two-sided trade taken on numbers: on the default Vulkan-enabled build, OFF avoids a -77.1% / -88.1% prompt regression and forgoes a +20.1% / +28.4% decode gain, ranges disjoint in all four. The flip itself changes branch selection and not either kernel, so no kernel was re-timed for it.

On a CPU-only path (-dev none) the same slot is +326.7% / +441.8% prompt and +19.9% / +23.6% decode, which is exactly why it stays compiled in and one env var away. An upstream bump that restored ON-when-unset would forfeit a measured decision while every anchor of the kernel entry still resolved.

A hot-sacrifice counter (heat_evictions) makes the policy observable rather than assumed.

wins.quality_gate: The policy must not change what is computed, only what stays resident: identical output against the plain-LRU arm, with heat_evictions readable and a steady zero meaning hot experts stayed resident. NOT YET RUN ON THIS ESTATE - see valid_conditions; the gate is stated so that whoever first has the hardware runs the right thing rather than inventing one.

Carried and inert here rather than broken: the Vulkan arm is wired, but this seat has never run a model whose expert working set overflows the pool, so the policy is not reached. wins._registered: 2026-09-05, lane-206 integration (R8). Landed on the integration branch by merge of lane-209/kernels; registered at the same time so the mechanism is guarded before any upstream bump touches it.
wins.mechanism: IQ4_XS gets a dedicated K-quant-style mat-vec shader (16 threads per 256-superblock, each thread taking both nibble halves of 2 packed32 words = 16 MACs per row per superblock, sub-block scale decoded once per row per superblock) instead of the generic mul_mat_vec.comp, which re-decoded the scale per dequantize4() call and used only one nibble half of each fetched word. Routed by `tname == "iq4_xs"` in vulkan-shaders-gen.cpp; the MUL_MAT_ID vec path picks up the same shader.
wins.quality_gate: test-backend-ops -o MUL_MAT and -o MUL_MAT_ID, 0 FAIL; F-141 content floor 0/8 on every slot with the baseline arm run first. A dequant mat-vec kernel fails silently, so a speed number alone is never the gate.
wins.workload: Radeon 780M gfx1103 Vulkan, llama-server serve A/B on U-IQ4XS and U-Q3KXL, DFlash2 Q4_K_M drafter at --spec-draft-n-max 2 (df2) and plain; palindrome 2 launches x 8 rounds per slot, cell-wise CI95. Op-level ladder: test-backend-ops perf m=17408 k=5120 n=1,2,3,4,5,8.
wins.measured_effect: LANE-BINARY MEASUREMENT (engine-before -> engine-r5, epochs E1/E2, matched 2x16 GB RAM): U-IQ4XS df2 +0.617 t/s [+0.255, +0.978], 8/8 cells positive; U-Q3KXL df2 +0.293 [+0.060, +0.527]; U-Q3KXL plain +0.742 [+0.208, +1.276]. Op ladder 98-105% of q4_K at n=1..4. U-IQ4XS plain +9.5% median with a CI straddling zero on both takes.
wins.valid_conditions: Radeon 780M gfx1103 under Vulkan; models carrying a material IQ4_XS share (U-IQ4XS 49.7%, U-Q3KXL 36.6%, U-Q4KM 28.7% by bytes). No remote carries an IQ4_XS mat-vec shader, so there is no upstream arm to compare against - an incoming change that adds one is a named collision, not a free replacement.
wins.notes: Registered from the lane's banked verdict, not re-measured at registration time. The numbers above were produced on engine-r5, a different binary from the integration tip; a different tree produces a different binary, so they are lane-binary facts and must be labelled as such.

wins._registered: 2026-09-05, lane-206 integration (R8), same reasoning as the IQ4_XS row above.
wins.mechanism: IQ3_S mat-vec runs 16 invocations per superblock (zuijdwijk 211abf6a9 body, via lane-166) at the UNION of the widths where it wins on this box: ARIFI_TPB16 = (NUM_COLS == 3) || (NUM_COLS > 4). NUM_COLS 3 is the DFlash2 n-max-2 verify width. Widths 1, 2 and 4 keep the upstream body bit for bit, because the no-sum[] form measured 7-9% slower at n=2 and about 20% slower at n=4 on the 780M - the `>= 2` gate (616b877b8) is superseded by this union gate for exactly that reason.
wins.quality_gate: test-backend-ops -o MUL_MAT and -o MUL_MAT_ID, 0 FAIL; F-141 content floor 0/8 on every slot, baseline arm first.
wins.workload: Radeon 780M gfx1103 Vulkan, llama-server serve A/B on U-Q3KXL (iq3_s 26.6% by bytes) and U-IQ4XS (11.3%), df2 and plain, palindrome 2 launches x 8 rounds per slot. Op ladder test-backend-ops perf m=17408 k=5120 across n.
wins.measured_effect: LANE-BINARY MEASUREMENT (engine-r5 -> engine-r4c, E1/E2, matched 2x16 GB RAM): U-Q3KXL df2 +0.820 t/s [+0.622, +1.018], 8/8 positive (8.367 -> 9.268, +10.8%); U-IQ4XS df2 +0.198 [-0.033, +0.430] take 1 and +0.199 [-0.004, +0.403] take 2, agreeing to three decimals across a driver epoch; plain arms identical, as the control predicts. The width GATE is itself the win: an incoming change that widens or narrows ARIFI_TPB16 must be compared at n=1..8 on this box before it replaces the union, because the 16-invocation body is measurably WORSE at n=2 and n=4 here.
wins.notes: Body taken from zuijdwijk 211abf6a9; the gate is ours and is the part that must not be overwritten. Registered from the lane verdict; the numbers are lane-binary facts, not integration-tip measurements.

wins._registered: 2026-09-05, lane-206 integration (R8). Registered as a KEPT NEUTRAL: no speed win is claimed here and none may be quoted from this entry.
wins.mechanism: mul_mat_vec_q6_k.comp reads its 16 int8 superblock scales directly out of the block instead of staging them through a double-buffered LDS tile with a barrier() per row. The exchange moved no data between threads, so the direct read is bit-identical by construction, and measured so. Specialization constant 3 selects the path; GGML_VK_Q6K_DIRECT_SCALES=0 restores upstream's LDS path byte for byte in the same binary.
wins.quality_gate: test-backend-ops -o MUL_MAT 1394/1394, 0 FAIL, on BOTH arms; plus byte-identical llama-server output between the arms (1 distinct sha256 per prompt across all arm-launches). Bit-identity is the gate this entry lives or dies on - it is the whole basis for keeping a change that buys no measured speed.
wins.workload: Radeon 780M gfx1103 Vulkan, Huihui-Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL + DFlash2 Q4_K_M drafter at --spec-draft-n-max 2; one binary, arms env-gated, 6 position-balanced interleaved launches per phase, Balanced power plan, 32+16 GB asymmetric RAM.
wins.measured_effect: NEUTRAL on gfx1103, and that is the whole claim. Op level: q6_k rows median ON/OFF 0.9796 against a control of 78 untouched op rows at 0.9990, p10-p90 [0.952, 1.053] - no q6_k row separates. Serve level TIED on all six prefill/decode cells at three prompt lengths. Output byte-identical, 1 sha256 per prompt over 12 arm-launches. NO SPEED WIN IS CLAIMED.
wins.valid_conditions: Kept because it is strictly less work for a bit-identical result - one fewer workgroup barrier per row per superblock, and no shared-memory tile - on an engine that ships to other people's hardware, where LDS pressure and barrier cost are not what they are on a 780M. Protected as a NEUTRAL: an incoming upstream change that reverts it is not a regression to fight on speed grounds here, but it must be compared rather than silently taken, because the mechanism's value is off-seat.
wins.notes: Also banks the falsification the next attempt needs: the per-row barrier was the leading mechanism for q6_k's reproducible ~35% mat-vec deficit on this box (41.0 GB/s against q5_k 63.8 and q4_k 72.5 at m=17408 n=3 k=5120). Removing it moves nothing. The deficit stands, unexplained.

wins._registered: 2026-09-05, lane-206 integration (R8), once the disposition was decided. Registered although the mechanism ships DEFAULT OFF: the President's capability law makes a capability droppable only when BROKEN, never when it is merely gated, and default-OFF describes the shipped default rather than the existence of the mechanism (same reading as the CHECKER-R3 R3-5 rows).
wins.mechanism: ROCmFP4-FAST gets the integer-dot q8_1 MMVQ mat-vec pipelines it never had. The q8_1 selector (ggml_vk_get_dequantize_mul_mat_vec) already LISTED GGML_TYPE_Q4_0_ROCMFP4_FAST, but no pipeline was ever created for it, so quantize_y was computed true on every FP4 mat-vec, the selector returned null, and the dispatch fell back to the f32 dequant shader silently at every width. The port creates the pipelines and gates them to the widths where they win on this box: MMVQ at n=3 and n=5 only, f32 at n<=2, n=4 and n>5. Since lane-206 the whole route is additionally opt-in behind GGML_ARIFI_ROCMFP4_MMVQ=1.
wins.quality_gate: THREE parts, and the third is the one that is still short. (1) test-backend-ops -o MUL_MAT and -o MUL_MAT_ID on q4_0_rocmfp4_fast, 0 FAIL. (2) The lane-206 adversarial set: `test-backend-ops test -o MUL_MAT -p 'adv='` run twice, default env and GGML_VK_DISABLE_MMVQ=1, over byte-identical deterministic inputs - the arms MUST differ at exactly n=3 and n=5 and be identical at n=1/2/4, or MMVQ did not dispatch and the comparison is void. (3) Served: F-141 content floor 0/8, zero empty completions, and an ON-vs-ON control run alongside the ON-vs-OFF comparison, because without it a text difference cannot be attributed. Byte-identity is NOT the right bar for this mechanism - an int-dot path and an f32-dequant path cannot be bit-identical by construction - but a first-token EOG or an empty completion is a hard RED.
wins.workload: Radeon 780M gfx1103 Vulkan, julianmb Qwen3.8-27B-ROCmFP4-FAST 14.56 GB (99.54% q4_0_rocmfp4_fast, zero iq3_s and zero iq4_xs tensors, so it isolates this mechanism), seated DFlash2 Q4_K_M drafter at --spec-draft-n-max 2 so the target verify ubatch is n_draft+1 = 3, and a plain arm as control. Op ladder: test-backend-ops perf m=17408 k=5120 n=1,2,3,4,5,8.
wins.measured_effect: LANE-BINARY MEASUREMENT (engine-r4 -> engine-r10, epoch E2, matched 2x16 GB RAM): drafted decode 7.498 -> 9.518 mean t/s, +2.0199 [+1.3212, +2.7186], 8/8 cells positive = +26.9%; plain decode +0.0016 [-0.0168, +0.0199] tied; prefill tied; rolled quality 32/40 -> 33/40; zero empty completions across 64 rounds. Op ladder x1.356 at n=3 and x1.313 at n=5, with a GGML_VK_DISABLE_MMVQ=1 control flattening every row to x0.991-1.007, which is what attributes the gain to the port rather than to build drift.
wins.valid_conditions: AMD under Vulkan, on files carrying q4_0_rocmfp4_fast, at widths n=3 and n=5 ONLY - the same port is a LOSS above the gate and was measured so, and n=2 produced a deterministic first-token EOG in a served cache-history replay and is deliberately excluded. INERT, not broken, on the seated Huihui line, which carries no ROCmFP4 tensors. Ships default OFF pending independent clearance; the mechanism is unchanged by that and the env var takes it.
wins.notes: What is NOT yet established, and must not be quietly dropped by whoever clears this: n=5 has never executed in served generation, in lane-209 or in lane-206 - the seated n-max-2 line emits n=3 and never n=5, so the width is live in the selector and exercised only by test-backend-ops. Also, the lane-206 op gate found MMVQ CLOSER to the CPU reference than the f32 shader on every adversarial pattern; that is partly structural and must not be quoted as accuracy, because this type's CPU vec_dot_type is GGML_TYPE_Q8_0 (CHECKED ggml-cpu.c), so the reference is itself an int-quantized-activation path.
